title: Store Update 1.41.0
body:
# Store Update 1.41.0

Raiders!

Store Update 1.41.0 is rolling out now, adding two new colour variants for the Vulpine outfit: green/camo and black. Anyone who already owns the outfit gets these colour variants automatically, with no restart needed.

Alongside this, a small hotfix is being deployed for Steam players. It targets a range of crashes and errors that happen when launching the game. Thanks go out to everyone who reported these issues.

See you Topside, //Ossen
